request_mainline: standalone process loads explicit bind, persisted-store, lease, and HTTP/TLS session-cookie policy before binding
account register or login establishes one opaque account-scoped access token
Agent control tunnel authenticates identity and persists account-scoped presence
directory subscription and proxy requests authenticate before accessing presence
transport opens typed data exchanges only through an authenticated control tunnel
optional FREEHAND_RELAY_UPDATES_DIR enables a separate Relay update route without changing tunnel or business payload contracts
response_mainline: directory query and subscription project account-scoped online state, role, status, last seen, and Agent-reported active-session count
HTTP, ADP, and generic WebSocket pass through opaque typed data frames without Relay ownership of Agent business truth
restart restores persisted account, token hash, and Agent presence records
Relay update routes stream deployment-staged manifest/APK bytes with no-store headers and preserve manifest payload bytes
error_mainline: invalid credentials and tokens fail explicitly
cross-account, expired, and unknown Agent access fails explicitly
corrupt store, failed persistence, and failed tunnel or local bridge IO fail explicitly
unset/inaccessible updates directory, missing files, and traversal paths fail explicitly; no daemon fallback is attempted
transport_invariants: local ADP bearer injection is admitted only for RelayDataProtocol::Adp and never for generic WebSocket exchanges
Relay Agent channel URL construction preserves deployment prefixes and mounts the relay API root exactly once
WebSocket and ADP data opens require RelayDataAccessScope::Remote while HTTP opens reject scope; the Agent bridge converts the accepted typed scope to the local remote-access header

shared_functions.why_shared: all authenticated Relay routes must resolve tokens through one account authority

shared_functions.purpose: atomically require live data and error return attachments before creating one typed pending response channel
shared_functions.why_shared: HTTP and WebSocket transports must share one account-scoped data/error admission owner without sharing payload semantics

call_table.responsibility: persist account password/token hashes and issue opaque token
resolve token hash to one account
authenticate and stream changed account-scoped Agent directory snapshots
call_table.output_semantic: typed directory snapshot or terminal frame

call_table.responsibility: validate and persist one authenticated Agent control identity, attach its generation-fenced control channel, then acknowledge identity admission before data/error channels can open
call_table.output_semantic: persisted generation-fenced control tunnel admission plus matching identity acknowledgement

call_table.responsibility: admit one data channel only when its server-issued control generation still owns the authenticated Agent identity
call_table.input_semantic: authenticated Agent identity, server-issued control generation header, and typed data sender
call_table.output_semantic: control-generation-bound typed data tunnel or explicit stale-generation failure

call_table.responsibility: open and stream one authenticated opaque HTTP exchange end to end, with one explicit pending-exchange failure owner
open and stream one authenticated opaque ADP exchange
validate a local-only target path and stream one authenticated opaque generic WebSocket exchange
call_table.input_semantic: namespaced generic WebSocket upgrade and local path

call_table.responsibility: validate the authenticated error attachment generation before a typed Agent failure can remove the correlated exchange, deliver its exact failure, terminate malformed or stale error channels explicitly, and generation-fence cleanup
call_table.input_semantic: typed Agent error frame plus authenticated tunnel identity
call_table.output_semantic: correlated pending-exchange failure or explicit terminal error-channel failure

call_table.responsibility: load explicit bind, store, lease, and cookie policy before serving standalone Relay
call_table.output_semantic: live Relay listener with fixed session-cookie policy

call_table.responsibility: load explicit Agent bridge configuration and enter the typed outbound tunnel lifecycle; its data-frame bridge requires remote scope for WebSocket and ADP opens, rejects scope on HTTP opens, and converts accepted scope to the local remote-access header
call_table.output_semantic: live control, data, and error Agent tunnels

call_table.responsibility: read the typed Agent status and active-session count at control admission and every heartbeat; terminate the tunnel explicitly when the source fails
call_table.output_semantic: current authenticated Agent presence heartbeat or explicit source error

call_table.responsibility: atomically admit one error channel only when its server-issued control generation still owns the authenticated Agent identity
call_table.input_semantic: authenticated Agent identity, server-issued control generation header, and typed error sender
call_table.output_semantic: control-generation-bound typed error tunnel or explicit stale-generation failure

call_table.responsibility: validate the authenticated data attachment generation before delivering an inbound response frame to current pending-exchange truth
call_table.input_semantic: typed Agent response frame plus authenticated tunnel identity and attachment generation
call_table.output_semantic: current-generation correlated delivery or explicit stale-generation terminal failure

call_table.responsibility: serve deployment-staged manifest and APK bytes beneath the canonical updates directory with traversal rejection and no-store headers
call_table.input_semantic: configured updates directory plus relative update path
call_table.output_semantic: update bytes or explicit configuration/not-found/path error
